Uses and Administration Oxcarbazepine is a derivative of carbamazepine (p.476) with similar actions. It is used as monotherapy or adjunctive therapy in the treatment of partial sei- zures with or without secondary generalisation. The in- itial oral dose for monotherapy and adjunctive therapy is 600 mg daily, given in 2 divided doses. The daily dose may be increased thereafter, if necessary, in max- imum increments of 600 mg at approximately weekly intervals until the desired clinical response has been achieved. Maintenance doses are usually in the range of 600 mg to 1.2 g daily or up to 2.4 g daily if given as adjunctive therapy or in refractory patients switched from other antiepileptics.
